noOverlap.notes: Inspect screenshots for collision or unreadable overlap.

noWatermark.notes: Confirm no source-site watermark, browser chrome, editor UI, or tooling artifact appears in production UI.

noHorizontalOverflow.notes: Confirm no accidental horizontal overflow appears at 390 / 768 / 1440.

noCutHeroObject.notes: Confirm primary hero/object is not accidentally cropped.

noDeadButtons.notes: Confirm visible controls either work locally, navigate, or are clearly disabled.

objectSwapInvariance.notes: Run object-swap-check for roster, gallery, selection, or configurator products.

blockers: Manual visual QA is still required.
